name: The Military
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality and timing of war, affirming that there is a season for conflict as well as peace (Ecclesiastes 3:8). The Lord is depicted as the source of strength and skill for those who engage in battle (Psalms 144:1). Additionally, governing authorities, including those who wield the sword in military capacity, are ordained by God to maintain order and execute justice, acting as ministers of God to restrain evil (Romans 13:1,4). This foundation encourages believers to respect and understand the role of military service within God's sovereign design.
